This is a Lean 4 / Mathlib repository for finite-dimensional quantum
information theory (quantum channels following Wolf's lecture notes, quantum
Wielandt theory, quantum Perron-Frobenius and spectral theory, entropy). Your
ONLY task is to scout Mathlib and the existing codebase for relevant lemmas and
post a scouting report. Do NOT write code or create files. Be thorough --
search multiple keywords and naming conventions. Mathlib sources are under
.lake/packages/mathlib/Mathlib/.
